title: Deep Research
tagline: Autonomous multi-source deep inquiry, citation synthesis, and evidence cross-validation

cases.title: Autonomous Agent Swarm Comparison
cases.description: Synthesize comparative analysis of hierarchical swarms vs peer gossip topologies with latency/cost trade-offs.
cases.prompt: Investigate architectural differences between hierarchical orchestrator swarms and peer-to-peer consensus agent meshes, citing recent papers and benchmarks.
cases.sample_output:
### Executive Summary
Hierarchical topologies demonstrate 40% lower message overhead for deterministic pipelines, while peer-to-peer meshes provide superior resilience for open-ended exploration.

**Key Citations:**
1. Google DeepMind (2025) *Multi-Agent Consensus in Local Contexts*
2. Stanford AI Lab (2024) *Benchmarking Agent Communication Graphs*

cases.title: Local-First LLM Runtime Landscape
cases.description: Comprehensive benchmark evaluation of llama.cpp, vLLM, Ollama, and Candle on Apple Silicon and Linux GPUs.
cases.prompt: Provide a comprehensive report on local LLM runtimes (vLLM, Ollama, llama.cpp, Candle) comparing tok/sec, memory footprint, and FP8 quantization efficiency.
cases.sample_output:
| Runtime | VRAM Footprint | Q4_K_M tok/s | FP8 Support |
|---|---|---|---|
| llama.cpp | 4.8 GB | 62.4 | Yes |
| vLLM | 7.2 GB | 89.1 | Yes (CUDA) |

cases.title: Postgres vs SQLite for Vector Embeddings
cases.description: Examine vector search throughput, memory indexing, and cold-start latency between pgvector and sqlite-vec.
cases.prompt: Evaluate sqlite-vec vs pgvector for local desktop applications storing under 500k 768-dim embeddings, focusing on startup time and RAM usage.
cases.sample_output: sqlite-vec is optimal for desktop agents: zero background daemon, <5ms cold start, and 45MB RAM footprint vs 250MB for PostgreSQL.

cases.title: Competitor Analysis: Enterprise Agent Platforms
cases.description: Assess security postures, data isolation guarantees, and pricing models across tier-1 enterprise agent platforms.
cases.prompt: Compare top 3 enterprise agent platforms on data privacy (zero data retention), self-hosting capability, and per-seat vs usage pricing.
cases.sample_output: Enterprise comparison matrix compiled across 14 security criteria. Agent Engine leads in local-first data isolation and zero-trust credential custody.
